<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="21" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">9:41</text>
    <line x1="300" y1="17" x2="306" y2="17" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="20" x2="308" y2="20" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="23" x2="310" y2="23" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="319" y="14" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="326" y="11" width="4" height="13" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="333" y="8" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="16" r="3" fill="#111111"/>
    <path d="M348 13 Q354 7 360 13" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="369" y="10" width="16" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="12" width="11" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="385" y="14" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top app bar -->
  <g>
    <line x1="18" y1="54" x2="34" y2="54" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="60" x2="34" y2="60" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="66" x2="34" y2="66" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="67" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">amazon</text>
    <circle cx="349" cy="53" r="3" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="342" y="57" width="14" height="11" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="367,51 367,68 382,68 382,55 375,55" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="369" y1="55" x2="380" y2="55" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="379" cy="50" r="7" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <text x="379" y="53" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">0</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="16" y1="95" x2="374" y2="95" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Main heading -->
  <text x="195" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Your Amazon Cart</text>
  <text x="195" y="157" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Your cart is waiting for something great.</text>

  <!-- Empty cart illustration panel and shadow -->
  <g>
    <rect x="55" y="180" width="280" height="208" rx="30" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="55" y="178" width="280" height="208" rx="30" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="280" r="77" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- cart handle and frame -->
    <line x1="115" y1="237" x2="137" y2="237" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="237" x2="151" y2="310" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <polyline points="151,310 274,310 294,250 143,250" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="271" x2="286" y2="271" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="163" y1="293" x2="279" y2="293" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="168" cy="326" r="10" fill="#111111"/>
    <circle cx="266" cy="326" r="10" fill="#111111"/>
    <circle cx="168" cy="326" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="266" cy="326" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- package -->
    <rect x="207" y="202" width="50" height="43" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="207" y1="215" x2="257" y2="215" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="232" y1="202" x2="232" y2="245" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="232,202 241,207 232,212 223,207" fill="#D9E7CB" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="278" cy="208" r="5" fill="#D9E7CB" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="278" y1="198" x2="278" y2="188" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="268" y1="208" x2="258" y2="208" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="201" x2="292" y2="194" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Action section -->
  <text x="195" y="425" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Ready to start shopping?</text>
  <text x="195" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Sign in to see items saved to your cart.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="55" y="470" width="280" height="44" rx="100" fill="#111111"/>
    <text x="195" y="498" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="55" y="526" width="280" height="44" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="554" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Create your account</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="55" y="582" width="280" height="44" rx="100" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <text x="195" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Continue shopping</text>
  </g>

  <!-- reassurance row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="82" cy="665" r="16" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <polyline points="75,665 80,670 90,659" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="106" y="670" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Secure checkout</text>
    <circle cx="245" cy="665" r="16" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <polyline points="238,665 243,670 253,659" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="269" y="670" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Easy returns</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="720" width="390" height="124" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="720" x2="390" y2="720" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,752 51,742 63,752" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="43" y="751" width="16" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="788" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Home</text>
    <!-- Categories -->
    <rect x="119" y="744" width="9" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="132" y="744" width="9" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="119" y="757" width="9" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="132" y="757" width="9" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="130" y="788" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Categories</text>
    <!-- Orders -->
    <rect x="198" y="744" width="21" height="22" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="203" y1="750" x2="214" y2="750" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="203" y1="756" x2="214" y2="756" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="203" y1="762" x2="211" y2="762" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="208" y="788" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>
    <!-- Cart selected -->
    <rect x="276" y="738" width="60" height="38" rx="19" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <polyline points="286,748 291,748 296,764 322,764 327,752 294,752" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="769" r="3" fill="#111111"/>
    <circle cx="319" cy="769" r="3" fill="#111111"/>
    <text x="306" y="788" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Cart</text>
    <!-- Account -->
    <circle cx="365" cy="748" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="365" cy="763" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="365" y="788" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
